title: Evolutionary Recurrent Decision Model in Developing Adaptive and Maladaptive Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2608.23932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study introduces the evolutionarily recurrent decision model (ERDM), a computational reinforcement learning framework designed to examine how evolutionary mismatch, bounded rationality, and satisficing contribute to adaptive and maladaptive behavior. ERDM simulates agents across evolutionary recurrent environments, including threat, prey/goal-pursuits, and alliances. Agents learn through competing rewards abstracted from survival metrics. A validity study under varying adverse childhood experiences demonstrates that distinct adaptive and maladaptive strategies, such as learned helplessness, avoidance, healthy relationships, and aggression, emerge naturally without being hardwired. These results align with empirical literature, showcasing ecological validity. translated_title: 进化循环决策模型在适应性与非适应性行为发展中的应用
translated_abstract: 本研究引入了进化循环决策模型（ERDM），这是一种计算强化学习框架，旨在检验进化错配、有限理性和满足性如何促成适应性与非适应性行为。ERDM在进化循环环境中模拟智能体，包括威胁、猎物/目标追求和联盟场景。智能体通过从生存指标抽象出的竞争性奖励进行学习。一项在不同不良童年经历条件下的效度研究表明，习得性无助、回避、健康关系和攻击性等不同的适应性与非适应性策略会自然涌现，无需硬编码。这些结果与实证文献一致，展示了生态效度。研究结果表明，许多与精神病理学相关的方面可被解释为在现代-祖先环境错配下运行的有限认知系统，这为理解心理健康问题提供了新的视角。
tldr: 本研究提出进化循环决策模型，证明进化错配和有限理性能自然涌现出多种适应性与非适应性行为，为精神病理学提供了新解释。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an evolutionary recurrent decision model demonstrating that evolutionary mismatch and bounded rationality naturally give rise to adaptive and maladaptive behaviors, offering a new perspective on psychopathology.
